description: This file defines the Comment class for managing comments in spreadsheet cells. It includes properties and methods for author, text, size, position, visibility, background image, and other formatting options related to comments in a spreadsheet context.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment in a spreadsheet cell, including author, content, size, position, styling, and background image.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Comment instance with default values.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Returns the author of the comment.

methods.name: setAuthor
methods.description: Sets the author of the comment.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the RichText object representing the comment text.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the RichText object for the comment text.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Gets the width of the comment box.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the comment box, validating the size.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Gets the height of the comment box.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the comment box, validating the size.

methods.name: getMarginLeft
methods.description: Gets the left margin of the comment.

methods.name: setMarginLeft
methods.description: Sets the left margin of the comment, validating the size.

methods.name: getMarginTop
methods.description: Gets the top margin of the comment.

methods.name: setMarginTop
methods.description: Sets the top margin of the comment, validating the size.

methods.name: getVisible
methods.description: Checks if the comment is visible by default.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the comment.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color of the comment background.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color used in the comment background.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the comment content.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Gets the current alignment setting.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the comment's state.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the Comment object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the plain text from the comment.

methods.name: hasBackgroundImage
methods.description: Checks if a background image is set and valid.

methods.name: getBackgroundImage
methods.description: Returns the background image drawing object.

methods.name: setBackgroundImage
methods.description: Sets the background image, ensuring it is of a supported type.

methods.name: setSizeAsBackgroundImage
methods.description: Adjusts the comment size to match its background image dimensions.
